claim: One click opens three realistic sample changes in a separate 24-hour workspace that can be reset.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; modify a review state, reset, and verify the original three records

claim: Each browser workspace can read and change only its own sources and changes.
sandbox: two fresh API cookie jars; create in one and attempt list and delete from the other

claim: The watcher extracts CSS-selected sections, tables, code blocks, and JSON-LD as normalized text.
sandbox: demo workspace; submit bundled table, code, and JSON-LD HTML to the sample extractor and compare text

claim: A check creates a word change at or above its threshold and ignores smaller changes.
sandbox: demo sample extractor; compare the same before/after text at zero and 100 percent thresholds

claim: Sources store daily or weekly schedules and provide a manual check action.
sandbox: fresh real workspace; create daily and weekly sources, click Check now for a deterministic fixture, and require a captured baseline

claim: The service rejects authenticated and private targets and obeys matching robots.txt rules.
sandbox: fresh workspaces; attempt authenticated and loopback targets and a disallowed demo robots rule

claim: The watcher limits responses to 2 MB and extracted text to 250 KB.
sandbox: demo extractor; submit content one byte over each documented limit and require 413

claim: The inbox stores unread, reviewed, archived, useful, and noise decisions.
sandbox: demo workspace; inspect seeded states, change an unread item, and read the saved result

claim: CSV export includes every change currently displayed in the inbox.
sandbox: fresh /demo page; download CSV and assert its header and three sample rows

claim: The interface works at phone width with keyboard focus and no serious accessibility violations.
sandbox: 390 by 844 demo viewport; assert no overflow, visible skip-link focus, and Axe serious/critical zero

claim: The app shell reloads offline after the first visit; inbox data still requires the server.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; install service worker, go offline, reload /demo, then close only that context

claim: The demo uses no analytics, tracking calls, remote fonts, or runtime CDNs.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; record requests through open and reset flows and require only the product origin

claim: The server limits a free workspace to five sources and daily or weekly checks.
sandbox: fresh real workspace; reject a 15-minute source and a sixth source at the API boundary

claim: Only a verified Pro session can use short schedules and more than five sources.
sandbox: fresh workspace with a server-signed 1-hour entitlement; create a 15-minute source and six total sources

claim: API request allowances return 429 with Retry-After when exceeded.
sandbox: fresh API session and forwarded client address; send 50 concurrent reads

claim: Deleting a source also deletes all of its snapshots and changes.
sandbox: fresh demo workspace; delete one source and verify its related change is absent

claim: A recent browser license verdict is reused for 24 hours without blocking the free inbox.
sandbox: fresh page with a current stored verdict; verify the free inbox loads and no license request is sent

claim: Demo, privacy, terms, browser history, and missing-page routes have their own title and heading.
sandbox: fresh browser; navigate legal pages, use Back, and request an unknown URL

claim: SQLite source data and the signed workspace identity survive a process restart.
sandbox: temporary data directory and secondary local server; create a source, stop, restart, and list it with the same cookie
